title: UI风格#209 - Retro Space Age (复古太空时代)
description: 创建第209种UI风格：复古太空时代风格 - 60年代太空竞赛、原子图案、未来复古。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planHA.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Space Age style When color palette Then features atomic orange, teal, cream, brown
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FF6B35 (原子橙), #008B8B (青色), #FFFDD0 (奶油), #8B4513 (棕色)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Space Age style When typography Then uses space age: Space Age, Orbitron, Astro
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Space Age (太空), Orbitron (科幻), Astro (太空)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Space Age style When layout Then atomic patterns, starbursts, mission control aesthetic
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：原子图案、星爆图案、任务控制美学

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Space Age style When UI elements Then starburst accents, atomic orbits, mission patches
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：星爆点缀、原子轨道、任务徽章

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Space Age UI When functional Then includes mission chat, astronaut agents, launch stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：任务聊天、宇航员代理、发射统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Space Age UI When copy Then uses space: 'Launch', 'Mission', 'Orbit', 'Astro'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'LAUNCH. MISSION. ORBIT.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'TRANSMIT'、'DEPLOY'→'LAUNCH'
